text: Student Mail Services Undergraduate Housing All letter mail and packages for the Seventh College housing community are handled by the Student Mail team. Letter mail and packages are distributed to the Seventh Parcel Center and mailboxes within 1-2 days of receiving. During peak periods (i.e. move-in, Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Prime Day, etc.), letter mail and packages may be delayed up to an additional 2 business days. Please use the information provided below to assist you with all of your Seventh College mail and package needs. Upon moving in to your on campus residence, you will be assigned a box number. The box number is used to ensure the Student Mail team can properly process your packages and letters. Your lived name and box number must be included in your mailing address. For proper and timely delivery, always use the following format: *Check your housing portal (QwikPass) or ask your Residential Life Office for your assigned box number. Parcel Center Location & Hours Location : Seventh College Parcel Center is located in Seventh West, Building 2 - Second Floor Hours : Open weekdays from 10 a.m. - 4 p.m. (excluding University holidays) Please be ready to present your Student ID and box number! Mailbox Location & Combinations Location : Seventh College mailboxes are located in Seventh West, Building 2 - Second Floor Hours : 24/7 Access with Student ID Please contact your Residence Life Office for your mailbox combination. How to Pick Up a Package at Seventh Receive an email from studentmail@ucsd.edu. Visit the Seventh College Parcel Center. Present your Student ID and box number to the parcel center staff. Receive package. How to Open Your Mailbox at Seventh Turn LEFT 3 times and stop at the 1st number. Turn RIGHT one full turn and stop at the 2nd number. Turn LEFT to the 3rd number. Pull to open! NOTE: Locks may need to be pulled to the right slightly after 3rd number to open. Students can send outgoing packages and letter mail at The Trove , located on Library Walk. The Trove is a full-service postal annex for all of your shipping and mailing needs. At The Trove, you can ship packages, purchase stamps or shipping supplies, and drop off prepaid USPS, UPS, or FedEx packages. thetrove.ucsd.edu Student Mail Resources We’re here for you! Check out our resources for step-by-step guides, frequently asked questions, and mail policies.
